I submitted a portfolio across all 47 industries (188 signals, each weighted by inverse volatility) that takes the reverse of the long-horizon trend signals (`tsmom_126`, `tsmom_252`, `ma_50_200`) and goes long the short-term `ma_5_21` signals. Its training Sharpe for 1970–1999 is 0.42, and it was positive in all six 5-year sub-periods, but its one validation check came back **FAIL**. I submitted it anyway rather than resubmitting variants until one passed, since a pass found that way would only be fitting the 2000–2012 data.
